method_note: Fixed small battery of ~4-5 WebSearch queries per candidate (English + Thai + one recent-news query), run 2026-11-07. Exa semantic searches were then used to resolve opaque google.com/goto redirect URLs to real publishers/dates, and a small number of pages were fetched (marked body_read=true; Exa fetches were often partial, first N chars). Judgement is from search snippets except where body_read=true. Window: only pieces dated 2024-11-05..2026-11-07 count toward the band; undated pieces are listed separately. Publisher-family dedup applied (e.g. Thai PBS = Thai PBS World; Time Out Group covers all Time Out Bangkok pieces; Bangkok Post = one family; The Nation/Nation Group = one family). Property portals, hotel/OTA content, tourism-authority (TAT) pieces and platform/UGC content (TripAdvisor, Pantip, Reddit, Facebook, Lemon8, Wongnai, TrueID, Trip.com) are logged with their commercial/platform context and do NOT count toward independent breadth. This measures EVIDENCE OF PUBLIC INTEREST (independent editorial coverage breadth), NOT popularity.

Snippet-based judgement was used for most items per task instruction; only pages with body_read=true were actually opened (and Exa fetches were often partial, e.g. only the first 4000 chars of the Fullsuitcase guide, so its riverside/Charoen Nakhon section was inferred, not directly verified).
Several search hits returned only opaque google.com/goto redirect URLs; their publishers and dates could not be verified and they are logged as unresolved/undated.

Property portals (PropertyScout, PropertySights, Baanlyy, Find Easy, Nestopa, Lazudi, Superagent, Siam Real Estate, eastblueth), hotel/OTA content (Avani, Royal Ivory, S15, Hotels.com Go Guides, Expedia, Trip.com, The Luxury Editor), the mall's own PR (ICONSIAM), and tourism-authority content (Amazing Thailand/TAT) are logged with commercial context and excluded from independent-breadth counting.
Platform/UGC sources (TripAdvisor, Pantip, Reddit, Facebook, Lemon8, Wongnai, TrueID, blognone community posts) are logged but not counted as editorial coverage.

Bands count publisher families whose qualifying pieces are dated within 2024-11-05..2026-11-07. Where a band rests wholly or partly on an undated single family (st.nana, st.phloen-chit), this is flagged in the families list; the true band could be one step lower (none_found) if those pages are pre-window.

st.nana: the high-visibility 'Soi Nana' editorial coverage (CN Traveler, Time Out) is the CHINATOWN Soi Nana and belongs to pom-prap-sattru-phai, not st.nana — a key risk if entity keys are assigned by name-match alone.

Exa 'published' timestamps occasionally disagree with on-page dates by ~1 day (e.g. Time Out Soi Nana piece listed as 2025-01-02T17:00Z); near-boundary dates (window starts 2024-11-05) were treated conservatively.
No paywalled pages were encountered; no paywall bypass or news-proxy mirrors were used. One WebSearch query failed with a concurrency limit and was retried.

Family dedup applied: Thai PBS = Thai PBS World = Thai PBS News (one family, appears under st.ratchathewi and pom-prap-sattru-phai); Bangkok Post = one family (phaya-thai and pom-prap); The Nation = Nation Group; Time Out Group covers all Time Out Bangkok pieces across candidates.
